automatic_path: AFTER INSERT readback trigger backfill_identity_readback_v2 is enabled in the retained fresh source catalog. For massive_reference it inserts a verified CURRENT_PAGE identity source keyed page:<task>:<page_no>, then projects the native results object at task.scope.asof.

Projection requires matching normalized CIK/member, both valid 12-character FIGIs equal to frozen anchor, security type equal to anchor, nonempty exchange, market=stocks and locale=us. It retains missing or conflicting identifiers as unresolved. eligible is true only when identifiers match and active is JSON true.

Only newly inserted immutable evidence marks affected member/cohort identity roots invalid and upserts the member refresh row with a 30-second readiness delay, preserving its earliest/latest date range.

Both ordinary claim prelude (private dispatcher28ae) and restored maintenance6c880 already call identity_refresh_pending_v2(2). This is an existing automatic successor; no manual helper invocation is necessary.

Refresh waits while linked retained_identity tasks are pending/running/retry-wait. It examines at most two eligible completed derive_daily roots per invocation, preserving original rows and checking whether a calculation receipt already covers the new material hash.

Missing calculation coverage produces deterministic backfill-identity-refresh-<sha256(root_task_id:identity_material_sha256)> tasks with original dependencies/scope plus the explicit refresh metadata, same run fence, and unchanged normal worker execution. ON CONFLICT reuses an already existing assignment.
The published intraday output path overlays current dated identity rather than duplicating its minute grid. New daily/breadth readbacks can propagate the established cohort refresh path.
Identity material uses an exact member/requested-date join. A July31 reference supplies no automatic evidence for another day or an unproved historical interval.

smallest_next_step.interpretation: A missing refresh row may already be consumed or may have had no completed eligible root. Reconcile existing deterministic children/material receipts and current-view holds before treating that absence as failure. Do not repeat the acquired page or replay projection helpers.

current_view_limit: The published current-view definition aggregates all member/day evidence and can keep the date held for conflicting, unverified or invalidated sources. Source inspection is not a live readback of that view; parent must use its actual persisted state. The retained acquisition projection includes active=true but does not itself export market/locale.

draft_progress_recorder_review.checks: Existing try-gate; current fixed owner/lease/fence/cohort/reporting/assignment; unique request; original full task hash; acquired status/count; exact body rehash, dated request, valid relay timing, readback count/hash, frozen anchor comparison; only existing queue state/progress/next-step and one immutable audit change; original/target/exception rows, other metadata and run counters compared unchanged.
draft_progress_recorder_review.scope_limit: If next-step text or identity evidence is sharpened after the parent readback, bind the changed exact bytes; do not treat this hash as a review of an unseen revision.

prohibited_inferences: No provider-absence conclusion from the original paper-Alpaca404.
No current Alpaca asset UUID or current Alpaca availability conclusion from Massive.
No full-period identity, full mission completion, point-in-time historical availability or derived-data completeness from this one dated row.
